system.description:
You and the target receive [Rigor]. You gain [Cancel (Attacks from Rigor Targets): SR × 5]. The [Rigor] [Cancel] are canceled at the end of the round, but can not be canceled by any other means.

(CR 11): The strength of [Cancel] becomes [SR × 10]. 

(CR 21): The strength becomes [SR × 15].

A special skill that attracts surrounding enemies and lays a desperate formation to receive their attacks.
